name: Digital clock (script)
author: WinDock
description: A scripted copy of the built-in clock: the time in a strftime format, optional seconds, the date under it in a format of your own, any time zone and a label; stacked (a smaller date line) or the Windows 7 taskbar look (time over date, the same size).

settings.label: Time format (strftime, as clock.format)
settings.description: How the time is written: %H is the hour (24-hour), %I the hour (12-hour), %M the minutes, %p AM or PM; %#I drops the leading zero (%#I:%M %p: 2:05 PM). Default: %H:%M.

settings.label: Show seconds
settings.description: Adds the seconds after the minutes; the clock then updates every second. Off by default.

settings.label: Show the date under the time
settings.description: Writes the date (e.g. Tue 03 Nov) in a line under the time. Off by default.

settings.label: Date format (strftime)
settings.description: How the date is written: %a the short weekday, %d the day, %b the short month, %m the month number, %Y the year; %#d and %#m drop the leading zero (%#m/%#d/%Y: 11/6/2026). Default: %a %d %b.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: Local time, or the time of any Windows time zone (with its own daylight saving).

settings.label: Label (e.g. Tokyo)
settings.description: Drawn small under the time: before the date, or alone without it.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: Stacked: the time large with the date smaller under it. Taskbar: the time and the date centred in two lines of the same size, as the Windows 7 taskbar clock. Default: stacked.

choices.label: Taskbar (two lines of the same size)
